advantages: Enables customizable multi-agent conversation patterns and dynamic group chats.
Natively supports human-in-the-loop oversight and tool/code execution integration.
Seamlessly connects with major LLM providers including OpenAI and Azure.
negativeConstraints: Avoid for simple single-turn chatbots where lightweight API calls are sufficient.
Not ideal for latency-critical real-time systems requiring fully deterministic outputs.
Unnecessary for workflows that do not require collaborative AI agent orchestration.
tools.description_zh: 用於建置和協調多 agent LLM 應用程式的 Microsoft 框架。
tools.useCase_zh: 透過協調多個透過結構化對話協作的專業 AI agent，自動化複雜的研究或程式設計工作流程。
tools.advantages_zh: 支援自訂的多 agent 對話模式與動態群組聊天。內建支援人類在迴路監督，以及工具/程式執行整合。與 OpenAI 和 Azure 等主要 LLM 提供者無縫連接。
negativeConstraints_zh: 簡單的單輪對話機器人若輕量 API 呼叫即可滿足時，請避免使用。
對於需要完全決定性輸出的延遲關鍵即時系統，非理想選擇。
不需要協作 AI 代理協調的工作流程則無需使用。

tools.name: Metagpt
tools.description: Multi-agent framework automating software engineering workflows using LLM-powered roles.
tools.useCase: Transform a one-line business requirement into a complete project structure with generated code and documentation.
advantages: Assigns specialized roles like Product Manager and Architect to simulate a real development team.
Generates structured engineering artifacts such as PRDs and design documents before coding.
Enables end-to-end automation of software creation from natural language prompts.
negativeConstraints: Avoid for simple scripts or trivial tasks where agent orchestration is unnecessary overhead.
Not suitable for projects requiring strict manual control at every development step.
Inappropriate for non-software tasks like data analysis or creative writing without modification.
tools.description_zh: 使用 LLM 驅動角色自動化軟體工程工作流程的多 agent 框架。
tools.useCase_zh: 將一行業務需求轉換為包含產生程式碼和文件的完整專案結構。
tools.advantages_zh: 指派產品經理和架構師等專業角色，模擬真實開發團隊。在編碼前產生 PRD 和設計文件等結構化工程工件。從自然語言提示實現軟體創建的端到端自動化。
negativeConstraints_zh: 簡單的腳本或瑣碎任務若代理協調為不必要負擔時，請避免使用。
不適合需要在每個開發步驟嚴格手動控制的專案。
未經修改，不適合用於資料分析或創意寫作等非軟體任務。

tools.name: Lobehub
tools.description: Orchestrate, schedule, and monitor autonomous AI agents for continuous 24/7 workflow operations.
triggers: 設定定時任務讓AI自動執行
tools.useCase: Automating the deployment, scheduling, and monitoring of multiple AI agents for continuous workflow execution.
advantages: Centralized dashboard for multi-agent coordination and lifecycle management
Automated scheduling and 24/7 operational monitoring capabilities
Native support for MCP protocols and modular skill frameworks
negativeConstraints: Single-purpose scripting tasks requiring minimal system overhead
Real-time latency-critical applications needing sub-millisecond responses
Strictly air-gapped environments without external network dependencies
tools.description_zh: 協調、排程和監控自主 AI agent，以支援持續 24/7 工作流程運作。
tools.useCase_zh: 自動化多個 AI agent 的部署、排程和監控，以進行持續工作流程執行。
tools.advantages_zh: 多 agent 協調和生命週期管理的中央化儀表板。自動化排程和 24/7 運作監控能力。原生支援 MCP 協議和模組化技能框架。
negativeConstraints_zh: 單一用途的腳本任務，需將系統資源消耗降至最低
需即時低延遲的應用程式（要求反應時間低於1毫秒）
嚴格隔離網路的環境，無法依賴外部網路資源

tools.name: Transformers
tools.description: Open-source library for state-of-the-art NLP, vision, and audio model training and inference.
tools.useCase: Fine-tune pre-trained language models like BERT or GPT for tasks such as text classification or named entity recognition.
advantages: Unified API for tokenizers, pipelines, and trainers streamlines development.
Supports PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX backends for flexible deployment.
Access to thousands of pre-trained models covering text, vision, and audio tasks.
negativeConstraints: Avoid using it for simple text manipulation tasks that do not require machine learning.
Do not use it when building low-level custom neural network architectures without leveraging existing model classes.
Not suitable for real-time embedded systems with strict memory constraints due to heavy dependencies.
tools.description_zh: 用於尖端 NLP、視覺和音訊模型訓練與推論的開源函式庫。
tools.useCase_zh: 針對文本分類或命名實體識別等任務，微調 BERT 或 GPT 等預訓練語言模型。
tools.advantages_zh: 統合的 tokenizer、pipeline 和 trainer API 簡化開發流程。支援 PyTorch、TensorFlow 和 JAX 後端，提供彈性的部署選項。可存取數千個涵蓋文本、視覺和音訊任務的預訓練模型。
negativeConstraints_zh: 避免用於簡單的「文字處理任務」，且這類任務不需要依賴機器學習。
當建構底層的自訂神經網路架構，且未使用現有模型類別時，不應依賴此套件。
由於依賴函式庫龐大，不適合用於記憶體限制嚴格的即時嵌入式系統。

tools.name: Cocoindex
tools.description: Incremental indexing engine for maintaining persistent context in long-horizon AI agents.
triggers: 維護 AI 長期記憶
自動索引 ETL 流程
長任務 AI 記憶延續
tools.useCase: Ideal for AI agents that require continuous, low-latency updates to their knowledge base as new data arrives.
advantages: Performs incremental updates instead of full re-indexing, significantly reducing compute overhead.
Combines Rust performance with Python accessibility for seamless integration into existing pipelines.
Optimized for long-horizon state management and persistent memory in autonomous agents.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for static, one-time batch analytics where real-time updates are unnecessary.
Avoid for simple keyword search tasks that do not require complex incremental state tracking.
Not designed for general-purpose relational database management or ad-hoc SQL querying.
tools.description_zh: 用於在長期 AI 智能體中維持持久上下文的增量索引引擎。
tools.useCase_zh: 適合需要在新資料到達時持續、低延遲更新知識庫的 AI 智能體。
tools.advantages_zh: 執行增量更新而非全量重新索引，大幅降低運算開銷。結合 Rust 的效能與 Python 的易用性，可無縫整合至現有管線。針對自主智能體的長期狀態管理與持久記憶進行優化。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於靜態且僅執行一次的批次分析，而這類分析也不需要即時更新的特性。
遇到簡單的關鍵字搜尋任務時，應避免使用，因為這不需複雜的增量狀態追蹤機制。
此工具的設計目的並非作為一般用途的關聯式資料庫管理系統，也不適合用來執行即席的 SQL 查詢。

tools.name: Stable Diffusion WebUI
tools.description: Feature-rich Gradio web interface for Stable Diffusion supporting txt2img, img2img, inpainting, ControlNet, LoRA, and a vast ecosystem of extensions.
tools.useCase: 適用於在本機或伺服器透過直覺完整的網頁 GUI 介面進行高畫質 AI 影像生成、細節重繪 (Inpainting)、風格 LoRA 應用與 ControlNet 精確控制的視覺設計場景。
advantages: 全球最具統治力的開源擴散模型 Web GUI，支援幾乎所有主流擴展與 LoRA/Checkpoint 模型
內建強大的 ControlNet、Tile Upscale、Prompt Matrix、X/Y Plot 與批量生成工作流
一鍵開箱腳本支援 Windows / Linux / macOS，並支援豐富的社群 Extension
negativeConstraints: 不適用於無獨立 GPU（NVIDIA/AMD/Apple Silicon）或 VRAM 極小（<4GB）的運算環境
不適合作為高並發、無頭（Headless）微服務 API 部署（建議使用 ComfyUI 或 SD API 專用伺服器）
初次安裝需下載數 GB 模型與 PyTorch 權重，需要充裕硬碟空間與網路頻寬
tools.description_zh: 功能豐富的 Gradio 網頁介面，用於 Stable Diffusion，支援 txt2img、img2img、inpainting、ControlNet、LoRA 及龐大的擴展生態系統。
tools.useCase_zh: 適用於在本機或伺服器透過直覺完整的網頁 GUI 介面進行高畫質 AI 影像生成、細節重繪 (Inpainting)、風格 LoRA 應用與 ControlNet 精確控制的視覺設計場景。
tools.advantages_zh: 全球最具統治力的開源擴散模型 Web GUI，支援幾乎所有主流擴展與 LoRA/Checkpoint 模型,內建強大的 ControlNet、Tile Upscale、Prompt Matrix、X/Y Plot 與批量生成工作流,一鍵開箱腳本支援 Windows / Linux / macOS，並支援豐富的社群 Extension
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於無獨立顯卡（NVIDIA/AMD/Apple Silicon）或 VRAM 極小（<4GB）的運算環境
不適合作為高併發、無頭（Headless）微服務 API 部署（建議使用 ComfyUI 或 SD API 專用伺服器）
初次安裝需下載數 GB 的模型與 PyTorch 權重，需要充裕的磁碟空間與網路頻寬

tools.name: Stable Diffusion Webui Localization Zh_TW
tools.description: Traditional Chinese localization extension for AUTOMATIC1111's Stable Diffusion WebUI.
triggers: 把 SD WebUI 改成中文顯示
安裝 AUTOMATIC1111 繁中語系
把 SD WebUI 介面繁中化
把 AUTOMATIC1111 網頁改成中文
安裝 SD WebUI 中文版擴充功能
tools.useCase: Translate the AUTOMATIC1111 Stable Diffusion WebUI interface to Traditional Chinese for local users.
advantages: Full Traditional Chinese interface translation
Seamless compatibility with AUTOMATIC1111's Stable Diffusion WebUI
Open-source community maintenance via GitHub
negativeConstraints: Do not use for Simplified Chinese; use the zh_CN extension instead
Not designed for ComfyUI or other Stable Diffusion interfaces
Does not auto-translate user prompts or generated images
tools.description_zh: AUTOMATIC1111 的 Stable Diffusion WebUI 之繁體中文本地化擴展。
tools.useCase_zh: 將 AUTOMATIC1111 Stable Diffusion WebUI 介面翻譯為繁體中文，供本地用戶使用。
tools.advantages_zh: 完整繁體中文介面翻譯；與 AUTOMATIC1111 的 Stable Diffusion WebUI 無縫相容；透過 GitHub 由開源社群維護。
negativeConstraints_zh: 若需支援簡體中文，請改用 zh_CN 擴充功能
此擴充功能並非為 ComfyUI 或其他 Stable Diffusion 介面所設計
不會自動翻譯使用者輸入的提示（prompt）或生成的圖像

tools.name: Langflow
tools.description: Visual platform for building and deploying LLM-powered agents and workflows.
triggers: 視覺化串接大語言模型
tools.useCase: Build complex RAG pipelines or multi-agent systems visually without writing boilerplate code.
advantages: Drag-and-drop interface accelerates prototyping of AI workflows.
Native integrations with major LLM providers and vector databases.
Deployable as a standalone API or embedded into existing applications.
negativeConstraints: Avoid for low-latency edge deployments due to resource overhead.
Not suitable for simple scripts where workflow orchestration is unnecessary.
May not fit strict closed-source compliance requirements.
tools.description_zh: 用於建構和部署 LLM 驅動智能體與工作流程的視覺化平台。
tools.useCase_zh: 視覺化建構複雜的 RAG 管線或多智能體系統，無需編寫模板程式碼。
tools.advantages_zh: 拖曳式介面加速 AI 工作流程的原型製作。原生整合主要 LLM 供應商與向量資料庫。可部署為獨立 API 或嵌入現有應用程式。
negativeConstraints_zh: 因資源開銷，不適合低延遲邊緣部署。
對於不需要工作流編排的簡單腳本來說並不適合。
可能不符合嚴格的閉源合規需求。

tools.name: Mem0
tools.description: Open-source memory layer enabling AI agents to learn and remember across sessions.
tools.useCase: Empower a customer support bot to recall user history and preferences across separate conversations.
advantages: Enables persistent memory across sessions without manual prompt engineering.
Supports vector and graph-based memory for flexible context retrieval.
Integrates seamlessly with frameworks like LangChain and LlamaIndex.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for stateless applications that do not require historical context.
Avoid for simple CRUD tasks unrelated to AI agent memory management.
tools.description_zh: 開源記憶體層，使 AI 智能體能在會話之間學習與記憶。
tools.useCase_zh: 賦予客服機器人能在不同對話之間記憶使用者歷史與偏好。
tools.advantages_zh: 實現跨會話的持久記憶，無需手動提示工程。支援基於向量與圖形的記憶體，提供靈活的上下文檢索。可與 LangChain、LlamaIndex 等框架無縫整合。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合不需要歷史上下文（historical context）的 stateless 應用程式。
避免用於與 AI 代理記憶管理無關的簡單 CRUD 任務。

tools.name: Ruflo
tools.description: Agent meta-harness for deploying multi-player agent swarms, coordinating autonomous workflows, and building conversational AI systems with adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, RAG, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes integration.
triggers: 建立對話式 AI 系統
整合 Claude 與 Codex 工具
搭建 RAG 搜尋引擎
自動化 Agent 團隊任務
建構具記憶力的 AI 對話系統
tools.useCase: Deploy a coordinated swarm of specialized agents (researcher, coder, reviewer) that share memory and adapt workflows across long-running autonomous tasks.
advantages: Native integration with multiple LLM providers including Claude Code, Codex, and Hermes.
Built-in adaptive memory and self-learning intelligence for evolving workflows.
Supports RAG integration for context-aware agent interactions.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for simple single-task scripts that do not require multi-agent coordination.
Avoid for projects needing a lightweight standalone CLI without orchestration overhead.
May be overkill for basic conversational bots that do not need swarm capabilities.
tools.description_zh: Agent 中樞框架，用於部署多玩家 agent 群，協調自主工作流程，並建構具備自適應記憶、自學習智慧、RAG 及原生 Claude Code / Codex / Hermes 整合的對話式 AI 系統。
tools.useCase_zh: 部署協調的特殊 agent 群（研究員、程式設計師、審查員），共享記憶並在長時間自主任務中調整工作流程。
tools.advantages_zh: 原生整合多個 LLM 供應商，包括 Claude Code、Codex 與 Hermes。內建自適應記憶與自學習智慧，支援工作流程持續演進。支援 RAG 整合，實現具情境感知能力的 agent 互動。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合不需要多代理協調的簡單單任務腳本。
避免用於不需要編排開銷的輕量獨立 CLI 專案。
對於不需要蜂群能力的基礎對話機器人而言可能過於複雜。

tools.name: Crewai
tools.description: Framework for orchestrating role-playing AI agents to tackle complex tasks.
triggers: 讓多個LLM分工完成复雜任務
用多Agent架構執行串联任務
設計AI代理角色扮演工作流
實現多步驟AI任務自動化
整合多個AI代理完成端到端流程
搭建分工明确的多Agent平台
tools.useCase: Build a multi-agent workflow where specialized agents handle research, analysis, and report generation autonomously.
advantages: Enables flexible role-based agent collaboration with customizable goals.
Supports multiple LLM providers and memory types for persistent context.
Simplifies complex workflows through sequential or hierarchical task execution.
negativeConstraints: Avoid for simple, single-step automation tasks that do not require multi-agent coordination.
Not suitable for real-time, low-latency applications needing immediate single-model inference.
Do not use for non-AI related backend services or standard CRUD operations.
tools.description_zh: 用於協調角色扮演 AI agent 以處理複雜任務的框架。
tools.useCase_zh: 建立多 agent 工作流程，讓專門的 agent 自主處理研究、分析與報告生成。
tools.advantages_zh: 支援靈活的基於角色的 agent 協作，目標可自訂。相容多種 LLM 供應商與記憶類型，維持持久情境。透過序列或階層式任務執行簡化複雜工作流程。
negativeConstraints_zh: 避免用於不需要多代理協調的簡單單步驟自動化任務。
不適合需要即時單一模型推論的低延遲即時應用程式。
不要用於非 AI 相關的後端服務或標準 CRUD 操作。

tools.name: Hermes Agent (Nous Research Coding)
tools.description: Open-source AI coding agent by Nous Research for intelligent software development automation.
tools.useCase: A software engineer automating complex refactoring and debugging workflows directly within their IDE using natural language.
advantages: Supports multiple LLM backends including OpenAI, Anthropic, and local models.
Provides autonomous agentic capabilities with memory and tool integration.
Fully open-source and customizable for specific development environments.
negativeConstraints: Not designed for general-purpose chat or non-technical queries.
Requires external LLM API access or local model configuration to function.
May incur token costs depending on the selected model provider.
tools.description_zh: Nous Research 開發的開源 AI 編碼 agent，用於智慧軟體開發自動化。
tools.useCase_zh: 軟體工程師直接在 IDE 中以自然語言自動化複雜的重構與除錯工作流程。
tools.advantages_zh: 支援多個 LLM 後端，包括 OpenAI、Anthropic 與本地模型。提供具備記憶與工具整合的自主 agent 能力。完全開源且可依特定開發環境客製化。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於通用聊天或非技術性查詢。
需要外部 LLM API 存取或本地模型配置才能運作。
可能會產生 token 成本，視所選模型供應商而定。

tools.name: Maigret
tools.description: OSINT tool for gathering public data on usernames across thousands of websites.
triggers: 查某個使用者名稱在哪些網站有註冊
搜尋某個帳號的公開資訊
透過使用者名稱找帳號在哪裡存在
查詢使用者的社交媒體帳號
檢查某個名稱是否被註冊
搜尋用戶名在不同平台的資料
利用使用者名稱做 OSINT 調查
查詢某個帳號的線上存在
搜尋網路上的使用者帳號
tools.useCase: Security researchers can quickly map a target's online footprint to identify exposed accounts or phishing risks.
advantages: Scans over 3,000 websites simultaneously for username availability.
Extracts detailed profile links and associated metadata automatically.
Lightweight CLI interface with cross-platform support and active updates.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for unauthorized surveillance or targeted harassment.
Avoid relying on results as standalone legal evidence without corroboration.
Ineffective against platforms requiring authentication or blocking automated requests.
tools.description_zh: OSINT 工具，用於在數千個網站上搜集使用者名稱的公開資料。
tools.useCase_zh: 安全研究人員能快速掌握目標的網路足跡，識別洩露帳號或網路釣魚風險。
tools.advantages_zh: 同時掃描超過 3,000 個網站的使用者名稱可用性。自動提取詳細個人檔案連結與相關元資料。輕量 CLI 介面，跨平台支援並持續更新。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不應用於未經授權的監視或目標騷擾。
避免在無佐證情況下將結果作為獨立法律證據依賴。
對需要身份驗證或阻擋自動化請求的平台上無效。

tools.name: Open Webui
tools.description: Self-hosted web interface for managing and interacting with multiple AI models and LLM providers.
triggers: 管理多個 AI 模型
整合多個 LLM 供應商
統一介面操作不同模型
建立 AI 模型儀表板
切換比對多個語言模型
連接多個 AI 服務 API
管理混合 AI 系統介面
tools.useCase: Teams can deploy it locally to centrally manage, test, and switch between multiple LLM providers like Ollama and OpenAI.
advantages: Native multi-provider routing for Ollama, OpenAI, and custom endpoints
Built-in RAG pipeline with document ingestion and vector search
Extensible plugin system supporting MCP and OpenAPI integrations
negativeConstraints: Production environments requiring out-of-the-box enterprise SSO and audit logs
Resource-constrained edge devices with less than 4GB RAM
Projects needing strict HIPAA or financial compliance without heavy customization
tools.description_zh: 自建式網頁介面，用於管理和與多個 AI 模型及 LLM 供應商互動。
tools.useCase_zh: 團隊可本地部署以集中管理、測試並切換多個 LLM 供應商（如 Ollama 與 OpenAI）。
tools.advantages_zh: 原生支援 Ollama、OpenAI 與自訂端點的 Multi-provider 路由。內建 RAG 管線，含文件 ingestion 與向量搜尋。可擴展的插件系統，支援 MCP 與 OpenAPI 整合。
negativeConstraints_zh: 需要開箱即用企業 SSO 和稽核日誌的生產環境
記憶體少於 4GB 且資源受限的邊緣裝置
需要嚴格 HIPAA 或金融合規但不進行重度自定義的專案

tools.name: Aider
tools.description: AI-powered CLI tool for pair programming with LLMs directly in your terminal.
tools.useCase: Edit code files and fix bugs in an existing Git repository by chatting with an LLM in the terminal.
advantages: Directly modifies local files and manages changes through Git integration.
Supports multiple LLM providers including OpenAI, Gemini, and local models.
Maintains project context to suggest accurate edits across multiple files.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for non-code tasks such as writing articles or generating images.
Avoid for users who require a graphical IDE interface instead of a command line.
Not suitable for real-time collaborative editing with other humans.
tools.description_zh: 可直接在終端機中與 LLM 進行配對程式設計的 AI 驅動 CLI 工具。
tools.useCase_zh: 透過在終端機中與 LLM 交談，編輯程式碼檔案並修復現有 Git 倉儲中的錯誤。

subTools.name: Business Growth Skills
subTools.description: Router/index for the 4 business & growth skills bundled in this plugin: customer-success-manager (health scoring, churn risk, expansion), sales-engineer (RFP analysis, competitive matrices, PoC planning), revenue-operations (pipeline, forecast accuracy, GTM efficiency), and contract-and-proposal-writer. Use when a growth/revenue request doesn't obviously match one skill and you need to pick the right one (e.g., 'which accounts are at risk', 'should we bid on this RFP').

subTools.name: Contract And Proposal Writer
subTools.description: Generate professional, jurisdiction-aware business documents: freelance contracts, project proposals, SOWs, NDAs, and MSAs. Structured Markdown output with docx conversion instructions. Covers US (Delaware), EU (GDPR), UK, and DACH (German law) jurisdictions. Not a substitute for legal counsel — use as strong starting points. Use when drafting a freelance contract, preparing a client proposal, writing an SOW for a new engagement, or producing an NDA before sharing sensitive material.

subTools.name: Customer Success Manager
subTools.description: Monitors customer health, predicts churn risk, and identifies expansion opportunities using weighted scoring models for SaaS customer success. Use when analyzing customer accounts, reviewing retention metrics, scoring at-risk customers, or when the user mentions churn, customer health scores, upsell opportunities, expansion revenue, retention analysis, or customer analytics. Runs three Python CLI tools to produce deterministic health scores, churn risk tiers, and prioritized expansion recommendations across Enterprise, Mid-Market, and SMB segments.

subTools.name: Revenue Operations
subTools.description: Analyzes sales pipeline health, revenue forecasting accuracy, and go-to-market efficiency metrics for SaaS revenue optimization. Use when analyzing sales pipeline coverage, forecasting revenue, evaluating go-to-market performance, reviewing sales metrics, assessing pipeline analysis, tracking forecast accuracy with MAPE, calculating GTM efficiency, or measuring sales efficiency and unit economics for SaaS teams.

subTools.name: Sales Engineer
subTools.description: Analyzes RFP/RFI responses for coverage gaps, builds competitive feature comparison matrices, and plans proof-of-concept (POC) engagements for pre-sales engineering. Use when responding to RFPs, bids, or proposal requests; comparing product features against competitors; planning or scoring a customer POC or sales demo; preparing a technical proposal; or performing win/loss competitor analysis. Handles tasks described as 'RFP response', 'bid response', 'proposal response', 'competitor comparison', 'feature matrix', 'POC planning', 'sales demo prep', or 'pre-sales engineering'.

subTools.name: Business Operations Skills
subTools.description: Use when running, diagnosing, or designing internal business operations — process documentation, vendor SLAs, capacity planning, internal comms, SOP/runbook authoring, procurement spend. Triggers on "BizOps review", "where's the bottleneck", "vendor health", "internal SOP", "all-hands deck", "spend categorization", "capacity for Q3", "process mapping". Forks context to route to one of six BizOps sub-skills (process-mapper, vendor-management, capacity-planner, internal-comms, knowledge-ops, procurement-optimizer) and returns a digest. Distinct from business-growth (external sales motion) and c-level-advisor (strategic, not operational).

subTools.name: Capacity Planner
subTools.description: Use when an ops leader (Director of CX, Head of Support, VP Ops, Head of BizOps, Head of IT ops, Head of Finance ops) is sizing ops capacity, building a headcount plan, modeling utilization risk, planning Q3 capacity or annual support capacity, or designing CS coverage — and needs Erlang-C queueing math, P90 demand sizing, shrinkage-adjusted FTE, manager-trigger thresholds, and a quarterly hiring sequence with ramp + attrition. Apply when sustained team utilization is above 80% or when the team is growing >50% in 12 months. Run before committing the headcount budget. This is NOT engineering capacity (see vpe-advisor for DORA + cycle time) and NOT strategic 3-year workforce planning (see chro-advisor).

subTools.name: Internal Comms
subTools.description: Use when a Head of People Ops, BizOps lead, or Internal Communications owner needs to draft and sequence an internal-only change-management communication — a re-org announcement, a tool rollout, a policy change, a leadership transition, a layoff, an acquisition close, or an internal product launch — and the audience is employees (not customers). Run this once before using inbox-triage for the first time. Re-run when business, pricing, or priorities change significantly. Triggers: 'set up my inbox', 'configure inbox triage', 'set up my email system', 'configure email triage', 'build my email knowledge base', 'initialize email management', 'set up inbox triage', 'onboard email triage', or any variation where someone wants to get the email triage system running for the first time.

subTools.name: Inbox Triage
subTools.description: Runs a full inbox triage using the knowledge base created by the 'inbox-setup' skill. Light-intake by design (most invocations skip questions and run with KB-default preferences); asks at most 2 grill-me override questions when invocation is outside normal cadence or includes category-skip intent. Searches recent emails, classifies them via the user's taxonomy, researches new senders, generates recommendations, drafts replies (NEVER sends), delivers a report in the user's preferred format, and updates the knowledge base with learnings. Designed to run on a recurring schedule (1-3x daily) or on demand. Use when the user wants their inbox processed, in any variation (e.g., 'triage my inbox', 'inbox triage', 'check my email', 'run email triage', 'process my inbox', 'what's new in my email', 'handle my email', 'email triage'). Requires the inbox-setup skill to have been run first.

subTools.name: Fable Goal
subTools.description: Convert a rambling description of a desired outcome into one polished, autonomous /goal prompt ready to paste into a fresh session. Use when the user says "/fable-goal", "turn this into a goal prompt", "write me a fable prompt", "write the prompt that builds X", or rambles about something they want made and asks for the prompt that makes it happen. The output is a single copy-paste prompt, never the build itself. Do NOT use when the user wants the thing built right now in this session — only when they want the PROMPT that will make it happen in a fresh session.

subTools.name: Handoff
subTools.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up. Save to a user-configured location (OS temp, home folder, or per-project .handoff/), redact secrets before write, suggest skills for the next session, and auto-load the latest handoff on the next SessionStart. First-run setup asks where to save so the project folder never gets cluttered. Use when the user says 'hand this off', 'handoff doc', 'summarize this for a new session', 'compact this conversation', 'I'm ending this session', 'pick this up later', or any variation signaling intent to pass work to a fresh agent. Also trigger on implicit signals: the user announcing they're switching machines, ending the day mid-task, or context is growing long without a natural stopping point.

subTools.name: Meetings
subTools.description: Use when someone wants to decide whether a meeting is worth calling, price a meeting in dollars, build a timeboxed agenda with desired outcomes, or turn messy meeting notes into owned action items — or says "should this be a meeting", "/cs:meeting-prep", or "/cs:meeting-actions". Runs a cost gate (ASYNC / NOT-READY / MEET), builds a decision-first agenda, and extracts an owner + due-date checklist that flags every orphan.

subTools.name: Reflect
subTools.description: Mid-conversation reflection skill that pauses execution and zooms out from detail-mode to honestly reassess direction, assumptions, and bias. Use when the user says 'reflect', 'take a step back', 'step back', 'zoom out', 'are we missing something', 'bigger picture', 'sanity check this', 'are we on track', 'are we overthinking this', 'forest for the trees', or any variation signaling intent to break out of detail-mode and reassess. Also trigger when the conversation has gone deep on implementation details without strategic check-in, or when the user shows signs of being stuck — that's often a signal the framing needs a reset, not more detail work. Intentionally low-intake: runs the 5-dimension analysis immediately when prior context is rich enough; asks one forcing clarifier only when invocation context is too thin to reassess from.

subTools.name: Roast
subTools.description: Use when someone asks to roast an idea, pressure-test or stress-test an idea, validate a business idea, "convene the panel", get a brutal second opinion before building something, or says "/roast". Spins up a 5-angle panel (Critic, Champion, Analyst, Investigator, Customer) that attacks the idea from every angle, then a Judge returns one GO / RESHAPE / KILL verdict with the cheapest test to de-risk it.

subTools.name: Weekly Review
subTools.description: Use when someone wants to run a weekly review, close open loops, audit stalled projects and commitments, get their system back to trusted, restart a lapsed review habit, or says "/cs:weekly-review". Walks David Allen's three-phase loop — GET CLEAR, GET CURRENT, GET CREATIVE — with deterministic scripts that inventory open loops, gate the checklist with named gaps, and score commitment health 0-100.

subTools.name: Atlassian Admin

Use when asked to add users to Jira, change Confluence permissions, configure access control, update admin settings, manage Atlassian groups, set up SSO, install marketplace apps, review security policies, or handle any org-wide Atlassian administration task.

subTools.name: Atlassian Templates

subTools.name: Confluence Expert
subTools.description: Atlassian Confluence expert for creating and managing spaces, knowledge bases, and documentation. subTools.name: Jira Expert

subTools.name: Meeting Analyzer
subTools.description: Analyzes meeting transcripts and recordings to surface behavioral patterns, communication anti-patterns, and actionable coaching feedback. Also trigger when users mention tools like Granola, Otter, Fireflies, or Zoom transcripts. Even if the user just says "look at my meetings" or "how do I come across in meetings" — use this skill.

subTools.name: Pm Skills
subTools.description: Use when coordinating project-delivery work across the 8 project-management sub-skills — sprint/velocity analytics, portfolio health, Jira/JQL, Confluence, Atlassian admin, templates, meeting analysis, team comms. subTools.name: Scrum Master
subTools.description: Advanced Scrum Master skill for data-driven agile team analysis and coaching. Use when the user asks about sprint planning, velocity tracking, retrospectives, standup facilitation, backlog grooming, story points, burndown charts, blocker resolution, or agile team health. Runs Python scripts to analyse sprint JSON exports from Jira or similar tools: velocity_analyzer.py for Monte Carlo sprint forecasting, sprint_health_scorer.py for multi-dimension health scoring, and retrospective_analyzer.py for action-item and theme tracking. Produces confidence-interval forecasts, health grade reports, and improvement-velocity trends for high-performing Scrum teams.

subTools.name: Senior Pm
subTools.description: Senior Project Manager for enterprise software, SaaS, and digital transformation projects. Use when a user needs help with project plans, project status reports, risk assessments, resource allocation, project roadmaps, milestone tracking, team capacity planning, portfolio health reviews, program management, or executive-level project reporting — especially for enterprise-scale initiatives with multiple workstreams, complex dependencies, or multi-million dollar budgets.

subTools.name: Team Communications
subTools.description: Write internal company communications — 3P updates (Progress/Plans/Problems), company-wide newsletters, FAQ roundups, incident reports, leadership updates, status reports, project updates, and general internal comms. subTools.name: Eu Ai Act Specialist
subTools.description: EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) operational compliance for compliance teams. Three Article-level decisions: (1) What's the risk tier of this AI system — prohibited (Art. 5), high-risk (Art. 6 + Annex III), limited-risk (Art. 50), or minimal-risk? (2) For high-risk systems, what's the Article 43 conformity assessment route (Module A internal control vs Module H full QMS + notified body) and what goes in the Annex IV technical documentation? (3) Per organizational role (provider / deployer / importer / distributor / authorized representative), what are the active obligations and deadlines? Use during AI system intake review, when planning conformity assessment, or when scoping deployer obligations. Cites Articles + Annexes for every output. NOT executive AI strategy (see chief-ai-officer-advisor). NOT a legal substitute.

subTools.name: Iso42001 Specialist
subTools.description: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 AI Management System (AIMS) specialist for compliance teams running internal audits. Three decisions: (1) Where are the gaps against Clauses 4-10 and what do we close first? (2) What goes in the AI risk register and which Annex A controls treat each risk? (3) What's the 12-month internal audit plan that satisfies Clause 9.2? Use when preparing for certification, scoping internal audit cycles, or onboarding AI systems into an existing ISMS (27001) / QMS (13485) program. NOT an executive AI strategy skill (see chief-ai-officer-advisor). NOT EU AI Act compliance (see compliance-team-eu-ai-act).

subTools.name: Agent Decision Receipts
subTools.description: Mint a tamper-evident, post-quantum-signed receipt for a consequential agent action (deploy, delete, pay, grant-access, model decision) so it can be verified later from the certificate alone. Use when an autonomous agent takes a side-effecting action that may need to be proven later, or when satisfying EU AI Act Article 12 record-keeping. Three decisions: whether an action needs a receipt, minting it, verifying it. Signing is delegated to the open-source OpenAgentOntology package. Not after-the-fact log analysis; not a hosted notary; not a legal opinion.

Use when users need to plan or execute FDA submissions, navigate 510(k) or PMA approval processes, achieve CE marking, prepare pre-submission meeting materials, write regulatory strategy documents, respond to agency queries, or manage compliance documentation for medical device market access.

subTools.description: Medical device risk management specialist implementing ISO 14971 throughout product lifecycle. subTools.name: Soc2 Compliance
subTools.description: Use when the user asks to prepare for SOC 2 audits, map Trust Service Criteria, build control matrices, collect audit evidence, perform gap analysis, or assess SOC 2 Type I vs Type II readiness.

subTools.name: Deep Research
subTools.description: Run a disciplined, multi-source research investigation for a high-stakes question or decision — fan-out web search across many channels, parallel sub-agents, source triangulation (each claim backed by ≥3 independent sources), an adversarial review pass, and every source saved to its own file with verbatim quotes for reuse. Use when a low-quality answer is expensive: strategy work, comparing N products/methods/markets, validating a hypothesis with external data, or mapping how a field works. NOT for quick fact-checks (answer directly), structured 12-dimension competitor scoring (use competitive-teardown), or fast topic overviews where the decision risk is low (use the research router instead).

subTools.name: Dossier
subTools.description: Decision-grade entity research skill — produces a hypothesis-tested dossier on a specific company, person, nonprofit, or government org, not a generic profile. Forcing intake makes the user state their hypothesis upfront (what they already believe and want to verify or disprove) so the dossier tests it rather than confirms it. Output is an editable Word document (.docx) with verdict on the hypothesis, identity facts, 12-month activity timeline, network and reputation signals, red flags, conversation hooks tied to specific findings, and source-provenance audit log. Uses WebSearch + WebFetch + free APIs (SEC EDGAR, GitHub, ProPublica) as workhorses; optional BYOK MCPs enhance coverage. Use when the user asks for background research, diligence, or meeting prep on a specific entity (e.g., 'prep me for a meeting with [person/company]', 'due diligence on [company]'). Honors sensitivity exclusions for journalism + personal-vetting contexts.

subTools.name: Grants
subTools.description: NIH grant research skill for clinical researchers. Grill-me intake (research idea + career stage + preliminary data + environment + submission posture + known institute targets) locks down the funding strategy before any search runs. Runs a 5-facet Consensus positioning analysis (with draft Significance/Innovation language), maps the research to the right NIH institutes and study sections via RePORTER, finds NOSIs and funded overlap, and produces an editable Word document (.docx) with budget/scope-aware mechanism recommendations, submission timelines, and a mandatory program officer recommendation. Use when the user asks about research funding or makes any grant-related request (e.g., 'grants for [topic]', 'find grants for my research idea', 'what grants match my research', 'help me find NIH funding', 'grant opportunities for my research'). NIH-only scope — non-NIH funders (PCORI, DOD CDMRP, VA, foundations) are out of scope and flagged at intake.

subTools.name: Litreview
subTools.description: Academic literature orientation skill that searches papers via free keyless APIs (PubMed E-utilities + OpenAlex) by default — with the Consensus MCP as an optional enhancement lane when connected — builds a strategic search plan using PICO (default) or SPIDER / Decomposition / hybrid as fallbacks, and synthesizes findings into a formatted Word (.docx) research guide. Grill-me intake (research question specificity + framework hint + tentative depth) before the recon search; a second forcing checkpoint after Phase 2 confirms framework + sub-areas + depth before searches consume budget. Configurable depth (5/10/20 queries) controls coverage vs. speed. Output is a 'launching pad' — an orientation guide that lets a researcher dive in confidently, not a finished review. Use when the user starts literature-oriented research (e.g., 'litreview on [topic]', 'literature review on [topic]', 'I'm starting a literature review on X', 'I'm writing a paper on X', 'help me research X', 'I'm doing research on X', 'can you help me research X'). Do NOT use for single one-off paper searches wanting a quick list — that's a plain PubMed/OpenAlex (or Consensus) query.

subTools.name: Notebooklm
subTools.description: Browser automation skill for controlling Google's NotebookLM. Use when the user wants anything done in NotebookLM (e.g., 'open NotebookLM', 'check my [name] notebook', 'ask my notebook about X', 'add [source] to NotebookLM', 'generate a Video Overview from my notebook', 'use NotebookLM Studio'). Handles reading and querying notebooks, adding sources (URLs, text, files, YouTube links, synthesized content), generating Studio outputs (Audio/Video Overviews, Mind Maps, Reports incl. Briefing Doc/Study Guide/FAQ, Flashcards, Quiz, slide decks, infographics — discover the exact set from the live Studio panel; the UI evolves fast), and creating new notebooks. Requires browser automation environment — fails gracefully when unavailable.

subTools.name: Patent
subTools.description: Patent prior-art and landscape intelligence skill — not generic patent help. Commits to one of five sub-use-cases via forcing intake (novelty search / freedom-to-operate / competitive landscape / acquisition diligence / litigation prior-art) before any search runs. Searches Google Patents, Espacenet, USPTO, and optionally Lens.org for citation-graph signals. Output is an editable Word document (.docx) with verdict, ranked closest art (claim-text extracted), CPC-class-aware landscape, family-resolved hits, geographic coverage, FTO flags where applicable, strategy recommendations, and full audit log. Use when the user asks for patent searching or analysis (e.g., 'prior art search for [invention]', 'freedom to operate analysis for [product]'). Produces search signal, not legal advice — always recommends consulting a patent attorney before filing or licensing decisions. Trademark, copyright, and trade-secret questions are out of scope.

subTools.name: Pulse
subTools.description: Multi-source recency research skill that takes the pulse of any topic across Reddit, Hacker News, the open web, and optionally X/Twitter within a configurable recent window (default 30 days). Forcing intake clarifies topic specificity, angle (trend/sentiment/problems/opportunities/comparison), time window, and platform scope before searching. Returns a synthesized briefing with citations, engagement metrics, and cross-platform pattern analysis. Use when the user requests multi-source recency intelligence on a topic (e.g., 'pulse on [topic]', 'what's happening with [topic]', 'what are people saying about [topic]', 'current conversation about [topic]', 'take the pulse of [topic]', 'trending: [topic]', 'find me info on [topic]'), and for competitor research, trend discovery, tool comparisons, and audience sentiment analysis.

subTools.name: Research
subTools.description: Default entry point for any research request — a hybrid router that classifies the question deterministically and either delegates to a specialist research skill (pulse for trends/sentiment, grants for NIH funding, litreview for academic literature, syllabus for course reading, patent for prior-art + IP landscape, dossier for entity research) or runs its own plan-decompose-multi-source-search-synthesize-cite fallback workflow when no specialist matches. Always surfaces the routing decision so users can override. Use when the user makes any research request that doesn't obviously match a more-specific specialist skill (e.g., "research [topic]", "look into [topic]", "what do we know about [topic]", "investigate [topic]", "find me information on [topic]", "do some research on [topic]", "I need to understand [topic]"). Output is a markdown briefing (default) or .docx document (on request) with full citations and an audit log.

subTools.name: Syllabus
subTools.description: Generates a curated supplementary reading list from any course syllabus using Consensus academic search. Grill-me intake (syllabus input format + course audience + year range) plus a grouping forcing-options checkpoint before any search runs — so the reading list matches the course's level and recency need. Parses the syllabus to extract topics and learning outcomes, searches Consensus for recent peer-reviewed papers per topic, and produces a professionally formatted .docx with clickable Consensus links, plain-language summaries calibrated to audience level, and Bloom-higher-order discussion questions tied to course learning goals. Use when the user uploads a syllabus, course outline, or curriculum document and wants supplementary readings (e.g., 'create a reading list from this syllabus', 'find recent papers for my course') — even casual mentions with a syllabus attached should trigger this skill.

subTools.name: Clinical Research
subTools.description: Use when designing a prospective clinical study before submission — selecting and classifying endpoints (primary / key-secondary / exploratory, with surrogate-endpoint flagging), estimating sample size and power for two-arm designs (means / proportions / survival), or scoring a study plan for feasibility and a GO / GO-WITH-CONDITIONS / REDESIGN / NO-GO phase-gate decision. Every output is an ESTIMATE plus a named human owner (clinician / biostatistician / regulatory owner) — never clinical fact, never a finished protocol. Distinct from ra-qm-team, which handles the regulatory/QM submission (ISO 13485, EU MDR, FDA 510(k)/PMA/QSR), not the study design.

subTools.name: Market Research
subTools.description: Use when doing upstream market-research methodology — sizing a market as TAM/SAM/SOM computed BOTH top-down and bottoms-up (never a single unsourced number), planning a survey sample size with finite-population correction and per-segment minimums, or scoring candidate market segments against Kotler's measurable/substantial/accessible/differentiable/actionable criteria. Outputs always show the method and the assumptions. For market-research analysts and product-marketing at the sizing/survey/segmentation moment. Distinct from marketing-skill (campaign analytics, attribution, demand-gen) — this is the evidence-building methodology, not live-campaign optimization.

subTools.name: Product Research
subTools.description: Use when planning and synthesizing product/user research as a method-and-repository discipline — selecting the right method for the goal (generative interviews vs usability test vs concept test vs validation), computing method-based saturation/sample size with an explicit confidence level, or synthesizing coded observations into insights while flagging single-source anecdotes. Never fabricates user insight; an insight requires recurrence across independent participants. Distinct from product-team/ux-researcher-designer (persona/journey artifacts), product-discovery (discovery-sprint planning), and experiment-designer (live A/B) — this is the research-ops method + insight-repository layer.

subTools.name: Research Finance
subTools.description: Use when managing the money for an internal R&D program or portfolio — building a multi-period program budget with the F&A (indirect) split, tracking burn rate and runway against value-inflection milestones, or routing R&D cost items to a capitalize-vs-expense determination. Every budget output surfaces its assumptions block; capitalize-vs-expense is decision-support only and routes to a named finance owner — it never books an entry or decides accounting treatment. Distinct from finance/financial-analysis (corporate DCF, close, valuation) and research/grants (funding discovery — this manages money already won).

subTools.name: Research Ops Skills
subTools.description: Use when planning, funding, scoping, or synthesizing enterprise research across workstreams — clinical study design, R&D program finance, market sizing/surveys, or product/user research. Triggers on "design this clinical study", "what sample size", "R&D budget", "burn rate", "capitalize or expense", "TAM SAM SOM", "market sizing", "survey design", "segment the market", "plan user interviews", "usability test", "synthesize research insights". Forks context to route to one of four Research-Operations sub-skills (clinical-research, research-finance, market-research, product-research) and returns a digest. Distinct from ra-qm-team (regulatory submission), finance (corporate close/valuation), research/grants (funding discovery), product-team (persona/journey/live experiments), and marketing-skill (campaign analytics).

tools.useCase: Deploy specialized agents and custom commands across multiple AI coding environments to streamline engineering, marketing, and compliance workflows.
advantages: Multi-agent compatibility supporting Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, and Cursor.
Broad domain coverage including engineering, product, compliance, and C-level advisory.
Includes customizable references and scripts for tailored agent behavior.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for standalone IDE features that cannot import external skills or agents.

tools.name: Council of High Intelligence
tools.description: Structured multi-perspective deliberation framework. Assigns hard questions to deliberately different analytical personas, forces direct disagreement, and returns a verdict preserving unresolved questions, dissent, kill criteria, and next concrete action.

requirements: Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI / OpenCode (one or more)

tools.useCase: High-stakes engineering decisions with material downside, competing values, or irreversible choices — e.g., architectural trade-offs, pricing models, shipping deadlines, risk assessments.
advantages: 18 grounded analytical personas with structured reasoning methods and known blind spots
Three modes: Full (complete protocol), Quick (breadth without adversarial round), Duo (single polarity)
Named triads for domain-specific panels (architecture, strategy, ethics, debugging, risk, etc.)
Multi-provider routing separates polarity pairs across different model families
Verdicts lead with unresolved items, kill criteria, and one concrete next step
Evidence labels separate FACT, INFERENCE, ASSUMPTION, UNKNOWN
Claude Code plugin marketplace support for one-click installation
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for factual lookups — use direct answers or primary documentation instead
Avoid for cheap and reversible choices — run an experiment instead
Do not convene a council to manufacture support for a decision already made
Requires significant token budget for full protocol deliberation
tools.description_zh: 結構化的多視角審議框架。將艱難問題分配給刻意不同的分析人格，強制直接表達分歧，並返回保留未決問題、異議、判定標準與下一步具體行動的結論。
tools.useCase_zh: 高風險的程式決策，涉及實質影響、相互衝突的價值觀或不可逆的決定——例如架構取捨、定價模式、上線時程、風險評估。
tools.advantages_zh: 18種紮根的分析人格，具備結構化推理方法與已知盲點，三種模式：完整（完整協議）、快速（廣度而無需對抗輪次）、雙人（單一極性），針對特定領域命名的小組（架構、策略、倫理、除錯、風險等），多提供者路由將極性配對分散至不同模型系列，結論以未決問題為先
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於事實查詢——應改用直接回答或主要文件
避免用於便宜且可逆轉的選擇——應執行實驗取代
不應為了製造對既定決策的支持而召開理事會
完整協議審議需要大量的 token 預算

tools.name: Grok Build
tools.description: Grok Build is an open-source coding agent harness and TUI for interacting with Grok models.
triggers: 用 Grok 審查程式碼
用 Grok 生成程式片段
用 Grok 建立 Coding Agent
用 Grok 整合開發流程
用 Grok 自動化編程任務
用 Grok 模型輔助編碼
tools.useCase: Developers use Grok Build to orchestrate autonomous coding sessions, debug codebases, and manage software engineering workflows via an interactive terminal interface.
advantages: Fullscreen, mouse-interactive TUI designed for efficient coding agent control.
Extensible architecture supports custom tools and tailored development workflows.
Optimized for leveraging Grok's advanced reasoning in software engineering tasks.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for non-code tasks such as creative writing or image generation.
Avoid for simple Q&A queries where a lightweight chat interface is more appropriate.
Not designed as a production-ready backend API for end-user applications.
tools.description_zh: Grok Build 是開放原始碼的程式設計代理框架與終端介面，用於與 Grok 模型互動。
tools.useCase_zh: 開發者使用 Grok Build 來協調自主程式設計工作階段、偵錯程式庫，並透過互動式終端介面管理軟體工程工作流程。
tools.advantages_zh: 全螢幕、滑鼠互動的 TUI 介面，專為高效程式代理控制而設計，可擴展架構支援自訂工具與客製化開發工作流程，針對利用 Grok 先進推理能力於軟體工程任務而最佳化。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於非程式碼任務，例如創意寫作或圖片生成。
避免用於簡單問答查詢，此類情境改用輕量聊天介面更為合適。
並非為終端用戶應用程式設計的生產環境後端 API。

tools.name: Codex Dream Skin
tools.description: Visual theme for coding environments with dream-inspired aesthetics.
triggers: 給編碼環境加視覺主題
自訂編程界面夢幻風格
為編碼軟體換夢幻皮膚
tools.useCase: Provides developers with an immersive, aesthetically pleasing interface for writing and reviewing code.
advantages: Dream-inspired color palette reduces visual fatigue
Seamless integration with popular code editors
Enhances focus during extended programming sessions
negativeConstraints: Not recommended for accessibility-critical applications
May lack support for specialized development tools
Best suited for personal rather than team environments
tools.description_zh: 具有夢幻美學風格的程式設計環境視覺主題。
tools.useCase_zh: 為開發者提供沉浸感強且美觀的介面，用於撰寫與檢視程式碼。
tools.advantages_zh: 夢幻風格配色降低視覺疲勞，與主流程式編輯器無縫整合，增強長時間程式設計時的專注力。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不建議用於對無障礙性要求嚴格的應用程式
可能缺乏對專業開發工具的支援
較適合個人使用而非團隊環境

tools.name: Lingbot Map
tools.description: Real-time feed-forward 3D scene reconstruction from continuous video streams.
triggers: 從串流影片建構三維模型
持續錄影重建立體場景
用影片做實時三維重建
實時重建環境的三維模型
tools.useCase: Deploy it in autonomous robots or AR apps that require instant 3D environment mapping from live camera feeds.
advantages: Zero iterative optimization enables sub-second inference
Natively processes continuous video streams into coherent 3D scenes
Scalable architecture supports dynamic and changing environments
negativeConstraints: Do not use when offline photogrammetric precision is mandatory
Avoid for single-image 3D generation without temporal input
Not intended for explicit mesh extraction or CAD modeling workflows
tools.description_zh: 從連續影片串流即時前饋 3D 場景重建。
tools.useCase_zh: 部署於需要即時從即時攝影機串流進行 3D 環境建圖的自主機器人或 AR 應用程式。
tools.advantages_zh: 零迭代最佳化實現亞秒級推理，原生將連續影片串流處理為一致的 3D 場景，可擴展架構支援動態與變化環境。
negativeConstraints_zh: 當離線攝影測量精度為必要條件時，請勿使用
避免用於沒有時間序列輸入下的單張影像 3D 生成
不適用於明確的網格（mesh）提取或 CAD 建模工作流程

tools.name: Opencut
tools.description: Open-source video editor featuring timeline editing, effects, transitions, and multi-track support.
tools.useCase: Content creators can produce and export short-form videos locally without relying on proprietary cloud services.
advantages: Fully open-source with self-hosted deployment options for enhanced data privacy.
Multi-track timeline editing with built-in effects, transitions, and text overlays.
Cross-platform desktop and web interface designed for lightweight performance.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for professional Hollywood-grade VFX or advanced color grading workflows.
Avoid for real-time multi-user cloud collaboration requiring enterprise permission systems.
Not ideal for hardware-accelerated 8K RAW footage processing on low-end devices.
tools.description_zh: 開放原始碼影片編輯器，具備時間軸編輯、特效、轉場與多軌支援。
tools.useCase_zh: 內容創作者可在本地製作並匯出短影片，無需依賴封閉雲端服務。
tools.advantages_zh: 完全開放原始碼，提供自架部署選項以增強資料隱私，多軌時間軸編輯內建特效、轉場與文字疊加，跨平台桌面與網頁介面設計輕量高效能。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合專業好萊塢等級的 VFX 或進階色彩調色工作流程。
需企業級權限系統的實時多人雲端協作請避免使用。
低階裝置上處理硬體加速的 8K RAW 影片素材並非理想選擇。

tools.name: Voicebox
tools.description: Open-source AI voice studio for local voice cloning, transcription, and speech synthesis.
tools.useCase: Content creators can locally clone a specific voice to generate natural-sounding narration without relying on cloud APIs.
advantages: Supports local inference with CUDA and MLX for hardware-accelerated performance.
Integrates Whisper for accurate speech-to-text transcription alongside TTS capabilities.
Enables privacy-focused voice cloning and synthesis entirely on user hardware.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for real-time video conferencing or live streaming voice modulation.
Avoid for tasks requiring managed cloud hosting or serverless API integration.
Not suitable for non-audio workflows such as image generation or code compilation.
tools.description_zh: 開源 AI 語音工作室，用於本地語音克隆、轉錄與語音合成。
tools.useCase_zh: 內容創作者可在本地克隆特定語音，生成自然的旁白，無需依賴雲端 API。
tools.advantages_zh: 支援 CUDA 與 MLX 本地推理，提供硬體加速效能。整合 Whisper 進行精準語音轉文字轉錄，並具備 TTS 能力。專注隱私的語音克隆與合成完全在用戶硬體上執行。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不建議用於實時影片會議或直播串流的聲音調變。
避免用於需要雲端託管或無伺服器 API 整合的任務。
不適合圖像生成或程式編譯等非音訊工作流程。

tools.name: Wand Enhancer
tools.description: Advanced UX and interoperability extension for the WeMod Wand desktop app.
tools.useCase: A WeMod power user wants to improve the Wand desktop client's interface and workflow.
advantages: Provides an enhanced user experience compared to the default Wand client.
Improves interoperability between WeMod and other applications.
Built with C# and WPF for a native Windows desktop experience.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for non-Windows operating systems due to WPF dependency.
Avoid if you require official WeMod support or closed-source stability.
Do not use as a standalone game mod manager without the WeMod ecosystem.
tools.description_zh: WeMod Wand 桌面應用程式的進階 UX 與互通性擴充功能。
tools.useCase_zh: WeMod 重度使用者希望改善 Wand 桌面客戶端的介面與工作流程。
tools.advantages_zh: 提供比預設 Wand 客戶端更佳的用戶體驗。改善 WeMod 與其他應用程式之間的互通性。以 C# 和 WPF 開發，提供原生 Windows 桌面體驗。
negativeConstraints_zh: 因依賴 WPF，不適用於非 Windows 作業系統。
若需要官方 WeMod 支援或封閉源的穩定性請避免使用。
不建議在 WeMod 生態系外作為獨立的遊戲模組管理器使用。

tools.name: Memos
tools.description: Self-hosted, lightweight note-taking app with Markdown support and real-time sync.
tools.useCase: Ideal for developers or teams needing a fast, private space to jot down code snippets, meeting notes, or daily logs without cloud dependency.
advantages: Zero-config Docker deployment with SQLite backend for minimal resource usage.
Real-time Markdown editing with instant preview and comprehensive REST API.
Complete data ownership with self-hosting and zero third-party tracking.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for complex document management requiring version control or rich media attachments.
Unsuitable for collaborative workspaces needing granular permission roles or enterprise SSO integration.
Avoid for high-volume knowledge bases requiring advanced search indexing or AI summarization.
tools.description_zh: 輕量級自我託管筆記應用，支援 Markdown 與即時同步。
tools.useCase_zh: 適合需要快速、私密空間記錄程式碼片段、會議記錄或每日日誌的開發者或團隊，無雲端依賴。
tools.advantages_zh: 零設定 Docker 部署，搭配 SQLite 後端，資源消耗極低。即時 Markdown 編輯，含即時預覽與完整 REST API。自我託管確保資料完全掌控，零第三方追蹤。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合需要版本控制或豐富媒體附件的複雜檔案管理。
不適合需要細粒度許可角色或企業 SSO 整合的協作工作區。
避免用於需要進階搜尋索引或 AI 摘要的高容量知識庫。

tools.name: Memos (MemTensor)
tools.description: Self-evolving memory OS for AI agents with persistent storage and skill reuse.
triggers: 保存 AI 對話記錄
複用 AI 技能模組
tools.useCase: Enabling an AI agent to retain long-term user preferences and reusable skills across multiple sessions.
advantages: Ultra-persistent memory ensures long-term context retention.
Cross-task skill reuse minimizes redundant learning efforts.
Hybrid retrieval optimizes accuracy while reducing token consumption.
negativeConstraints: Stateless applications that do not require memory persistence.
Non-LLM based traditional software systems.
Single-turn queries needing immediate responses without context.
tools.description_zh: 具備持久化儲存與技能復用的 AI 代理自演化記憶作業系統。
tools.useCase_zh: 讓 AI 代理能在多個工作階段中保留長期使用者偏好與可復用的技能。
tools.advantages_zh: 超高持久化記憶確保長期語境保留。跨任務技能復用減少冗餘學習。混合式檢索在降低 token 消耗的同時優化準確率。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不需要記憶體持久化的無狀態應用程式。
基於 LLM 之外的傳統軟體系統。
需要立即回應且無需上下文的一步查詢。

tools.name: Metaharness
tools.description: Scaffold branded AI agent harnesses with MCP, memory, and multi-agent support.
triggers: 搭建 AI agent 框架
設定 AI 代理記憶體
創建沙箱化 AI 環境
實作多個 AI agent 協作
初始化 AI 系統骨架
部署具隔離性的 AI agent
串接 MCP 工具的 AI 架構

subTools.name: Compare Harnesses
subTools.description: Diff two scaffolded harnesses (ADR-031). Reports manifest meta drift + host list + per-file fingerprint changes (added/removed/changed). Exits 0 IDENTICAL, 1 DRIFT, 2 missing manifest. Use --bundle for the ADR-031 schema-1 JSON envelope.

subTools.name: Create Harness
subTools.description: Scaffold your own focused AI agent harness — pick host (Claude Code, Codex, pi.dev, Hermes), template, agents, skills, and ship a npm-publishable harness with its own npx CLI. Use when a user asks to "create my own agent harness", "scaffold a harness", "make a custom Claude Code plugin like ruflo", or "build a vertical AI assistant for X".

subTools.name: Diag Harness
subTools.description: Kernel-version skew check (ADR-027). Reports manifest surface + manifest kernel + installed kernel + verdict (match/patch-diff/minor-diff/major-diff). Exits 1 on minor/major skew with a copy-pasteable `npm install @metaharness/kernel@X.Y.Z` next step. Exits 2 if no .harness/manifest.json at path.

subTools.name: Example Harness
subTools.description: Scaffold a ready-made AI agent harness in one command from the 19 published @metaharness/* example packages — 9 host integrations (Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, pi.dev, OpenClaw, RVM, Copilot, OpenCode, GitHub Actions) + 10 vertical pods (devops, research, trading, support, legal, coding, education, sales, gaming, repo-maintainer).

subTools.name: Harness Secrets
subTools.description: GCP Secret Manager integration: validate setup, fetch values, or confirm an NPM_TOKEN is non-revoked via `npm whoami`. Used for publish-time token rotation without long-lived keys in CI.

subTools.name: List Templates
subTools.description: List the available harness templates and what each one ships with. Use when the user asks "what templates are available", "what verticals does the harness generator support", or "show me what I can scaffold".

subTools.name: Oia Manifest
subTools.description: Emit .harness/oia-manifest.json declaring layer alignment with the OIA v0.1 9-layer reference architecture. Self-describes the harness's MCP wiring, witness signing, audit log, identity posture (always 'none' at v0.1). --check verifies an existing manifest, --dry-run prints without writing, --json emits to stdout.

subTools.name: Publish Harness
subTools.description: Publish a generated harness to npm — runs the smoke test, signs the witness manifest, and dispatches `npm publish --provenance` from your tagged release.

subTools.name: Repo Genome
subTools.description: 7-section readiness scorecard for a LOCAL repo. Reports repo type + agent topology + MCP risk + test confidence + release readiness + recommended harness plan + scorecard. Exit 0 ready, 1 needs-work, 2 blocked. --json for the 6-field scorecard, --bundle for the ADR-031 schema-1 envelope.

subTools.name: Score Harness
subTools.description: 5-dimension scorecard (0-100, grade A/B/C/F) for a scaffolded harness. Dimensions: Repo understanding (25%), Agent usefulness (25%), MCP safety (20%), Test coverage (15%), Publish readiness (15%). Emits a 6-field badges block (score + mcpRisk + 4 booleans) ready for the harness README. Exit 0 A/B, 1 C, 2 F.

subTools.name: Threat Model
subTools.description: MCP threat-model artifact for a scaffolded harness. Reports allowed/denied tools, dangerous permissions count, secrets reachability, network/shell/file-write grants, default-deny posture. Verdict: clean (exit 0) / medium (exit 1) / high (exit 2). The 'enterprise gold' artifact for PR + compliance review.

subTools.name: Upgrade Harness
subTools.description: Drift detection + apply for a scaffolded harness. Re-renders the template with the same vars, computes added/removed/changed file plan, and applies with Git-style conflict markers or .rej files. Default is dry-run.

subTools.name: Validate Harness
subTools.description: Release-readiness umbrella check for a scaffolded harness — runs doctor, witness verify, hardcoded-path scan, MCP server config, and GCP Secret Manager validation in one shot. Exits non-zero if any sub-check fails.

subTools.name: Verify Witness
subTools.description: Verify the Ed25519 witness manifest of a scaffolded harness. Fast yes/no signature check that proves the publisher signed this exact file set — separate from the full release-readiness umbrella in validate-harness.

tools.useCase: Build a custom-branded AI coding assistant with persistent memory and MCP integration for team workflows.
advantages: Generates a complete agent environment with npx CLI, MCP server, and memory out of the box.
Supports multiple AI backends including Claude Code, Codex, and hardware-isolated RVM sandboxes.
Enables witness-signed releases for secure, verifiable agent updates.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for simple script execution or one-off automation tasks without an agent framework.
Avoid if you need a managed cloud-hosted agent service rather than a self-hosted scaffold.
Not ideal for non-AI software development projects.
tools.description_zh: 使用 MCP、記憶與多代理支援來建構品牌化 AI 代理底座的雛型工具。
tools.useCase_zh: 建構具備持久記憶與 MCP 整合的自訂品牌 AI 編程助手，適用於團隊工作流程。
tools.advantages_zh: 透過 npx CLI 一鍵生成完整的代理環境，內建 MCP 伺服器與記憶功能。支援多種 AI 後端，包括 Claude Code、Codex 及硬體隔離的 RVM 沙箱。支援見證簽章發布，實現安全可驗證的代理更新。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合沒有 agent 框架的簡單腳本執行或一次性自動化任務。
避免選擇需要托管雲端 agent 服務而非自架結構框架的專案。
不適合非 AI 軟體開發專案。

建立穩定AI Agent運作環境
處理Agent執行異常的救援機制
架構可自我修復的Agent系統
設定Agent生命週期管理流程
實作Agent執行中斷後的自動恢復
建立高可用性AI Agent運行架構
tools.useCase: Useful when developing autonomous agents that require persistent state management and error recovery over extended periods.
advantages: Teaches patterns for resilient agent infrastructure
Addresses challenges in long-duration autonomous execution
Covers Harness Engineering principles for LLM-based systems
negativeConstraints: Do not use for simple chatbot implementations lacking complex state
Avoid for projects needing a pre-built agent framework rather than architectural guidance
Not intended for non-AI software development tasks
tools.description_zh: 建構長期執行 AI 代理之健壯執行階段架構的開源指南。
tools.useCase_zh: 適合開發需要持久狀態管理與長期錯誤恢復的自主代理。
tools.advantages_zh: 教導 resilient 代理基礎設施模式、解決長時間自主執行的挑戰、涵蓋 LLM 系統的 Harness Engineering 原則
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於缺乏複雜狀態的簡單聊天機器人實作。
避免用於需要預建 agent 框架而非架構指導的專案。
不適用於非 AI 軟體開發任務。

tools.name: Browser Harness
tools.description: Autonomous self-healing browser automation framework for LLM-driven web task execution.
tools.useCase: Automating complex, multi-step e-commerce checkouts or dynamic form submissions without manual script maintenance.
advantages: Self-healing UI selectors adapt automatically to DOM changes
Leverages CDP for reliable headless and cloud browser integration
Native LLM orchestration minimizes prompt engineering overhead
negativeConstraints: Real-time high-frequency trading systems requiring sub-millisecond latency
Static internal dashboards better handled by simple HTTP requests
Strict zero-trust environments blocking external CDP connections
tools.description_zh: 適用於 LLM 驅動網頁任務執行的自主自我修復瀏覽器自動化框架。
tools.useCase_zh: 自動化複雜的多步驟電商結帳或動態表單提交，無需手動維護腳本。
tools.advantages_zh: 自我修復 UI 選擇器自動適應 DOM 變更、利用 CDP 實現可靠的無頭及雲端瀏覽器整合、原生 LLM 編排最小化 prompt engineering 負擔
negativeConstraints_zh: 需要子毫秒延遲的即時高頻交易系統。
以簡單 HTTP 請求即可處理的靜態內部儀表板。
封鎖外部 CDP 連線的嚴格零信任環境。

tools.name: OpenHarness
tools.description: Open-source framework for building, running, and benchmarking autonomous LLM agents with personalization.
triggers: 搭建 LLM agent 框架
評測 AI agent 效能
執行 LLM agent 流程
評估 AI 代理任務表現
訓練自閉環 LLM 系統
測試多工具 agent 整合
建構可微調的自動代理

advantages: Provides a standardized benchmarking environment for evaluating autonomous agent performance.
Supports modular tool integration and customizable agent configurations.
Includes a built-in personal agent for immediate usability and personalization testing.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for production-grade, low-latency applications requiring strict service-level agreements.
Avoid using for simple deterministic script automation that does not require LLM-based reasoning.
Not designed for fine-tuning base language models rather than orchestrating agent behaviors.
tools.description_zh: 用於建構、執行與基準測試具個人化自主 LLM 代理的開源框架。

tools.name: Humanizer

tools.useCase: Rewrite AI-generated blog posts or marketing copy to bypass detection tools and improve readability.
advantages: Eliminates repetitive phrasing common in automated output.
Maintains original intent while varying sentence structure.
Integrates into development workflows for fast text iteration.
negativeConstraints: Avoid for legal, medical, or technical docs needing exact terminology.
Do not use for formal academic papers requiring strict objectivity.

subTools.name: Ai Readiness

subTools.name: Dd Checklist
subTools.description: Generate and track comprehensive due diligence checklists tailored to the target company's sector, deal type, and complexity. Covers all major workstreams with request lists, status tracking, and red flag escalation. Use when kicking off diligence, organizing a data room review, or tracking outstanding items. Triggers on "dd checklist", "due diligence tracker", "diligence request list", "what do we still need", or "data room review".

subTools.name: Dd Meeting Prep
subTools.description: Prepare for due diligence meetings — management presentations, expert network calls, customer references, and advisor sessions. Generates targeted question lists, benchmarks to reference, and red flags to probe. Use before any diligence meeting or call. Triggers on "prep for management meeting", "diligence call prep", "expert call questions", "customer reference questions", or "meeting prep for [company]".

subTools.name: Deal Screening
subTools.description: Quickly screen inbound deal flow — CIMs, teasers, and broker materials — against the fund's investment criteria. Extracts key deal metrics, runs a pass/fail framework, and outputs a one-page screening memo. Use when reviewing new deal flow, triaging inbound materials, or deciding whether to take a first call. Triggers on "screen this deal", "review this CIM", "should we look at this", "triage this teaser", or "deal screening".

subTools.name: Deal Sourcing
subTools.description: PE deal sourcing workflow — discover target companies, check CRM for existing relationships, and draft personalized founder outreach emails. Use when sourcing new deals, prospecting companies in a sector, or reaching out to founders. Triggers on "find companies", "source deals", "draft founder email", "check if we've seen this company", or "outreach to founder".

subTools.name: Ic Memo
subTools.description: Draft a structured investment committee memo for PE deal approval. Synthesizes due diligence findings, financial analysis, and deal terms into a professional IC-ready document. Use when preparing for investment committee, writing up a deal, or creating a formal recommendation. Triggers on "write IC memo", "investment committee memo", "deal write-up", "prepare IC materials", or "recommendation memo".

subTools.name: Portfolio Monitoring
subTools.description: Track and analyze portfolio company performance against plan. Ingests monthly/quarterly financial packages (Excel, PDF), extracts KPIs, flags variances to budget, and produces summary dashboards. Use when reviewing portfolio company financials, preparing board materials, or monitoring covenant compliance. Triggers on "review portfolio company", "monthly financials", "how is [company] performing", "covenant check", or "portfolio update".

subTools.name: Returns Analysis
subTools.description: Build quick IRR/MOIC sensitivity tables for PE deal evaluation. Models returns across entry multiple, leverage, exit multiple, growth, and hold period scenarios. Use when sizing up a deal, stress-testing assumptions, or preparing IC returns exhibits. Triggers on "returns analysis", "IRR sensitivity", "MOIC table", "what's the return at", "model the returns", or "back of the envelope".

subTools.name: Unit Economics
subTools.description: Analyze unit economics for PE targets — ARR cohorts, LTV/CAC, net retention, payback periods, revenue quality, and margin waterfall. Essential for software/SaaS, recurring revenue, and subscription businesses. Use when evaluating revenue quality, building a cohort analysis, or assessing customer economics. Triggers on "unit economics", "cohort analysis", "ARR analysis", "LTV CAC", "net retention", "revenue quality", or "customer economics".

subTools.name: Value Creation Plan
subTools.description: Structure post-acquisition value creation plans with revenue, cost, and operational levers mapped to an EBITDA bridge. Includes 100-day priorities, KPI targets, and accountability frameworks. Use when planning post-close execution, preparing operating partner materials, or building a board-ready value creation roadmap. Triggers on "value creation plan", "100-day plan", "post-close plan", "EBITDA bridge", "operating plan", or "value creation levers".

subTools.name: Client Report
subTools.description: Generate professional client-facing performance reports with portfolio returns, allocation breakdowns, and market commentary. Suitable for quarterly or annual distribution. Triggers on "client report", "performance report", "quarterly report for [client]", "generate reports", or "client statement".

subTools.name: Client Review
subTools.description: Prepare for client review meetings with portfolio performance summary, allocation analysis, talking points, and action items. Pulls together account data into a concise meeting-ready format. Use before quarterly reviews, annual checkups, or ad-hoc client meetings. Triggers on "client review", "meeting prep for [client]", "quarterly review", "prep for [client name]", or "client meeting".

subTools.name: Financial Plan
subTools.description: Build or update a comprehensive financial plan covering retirement projections, education funding, estate planning, and cash flow analysis. Use for new client onboarding, annual plan reviews, or scenario modeling. Triggers on "financial plan", "retirement plan", "can I retire", "education funding", "estate plan", "cash flow analysis", or "plan update".

subTools.name: Investment Proposal
subTools.description: Create professional investment proposals for prospective clients. Covers the firm's approach, proposed allocation, expected outcomes, and fee structure. Use when pitching new clients or presenting a new investment strategy. Triggers on "investment proposal", "prospect presentation", "pitch new client", "proposal for [client]", or "new client presentation".

subTools.name: Portfolio Rebalance
subTools.description: Analyze portfolio allocation drift and generate rebalancing trade recommendations across accounts. Considers tax implications, transaction costs, and wash sale rules. Triggers on "rebalance", "portfolio drift", "allocation check", "rebalancing trades", or "my portfolio is out of balance".

subTools.name: Tax Loss Harvesting
subTools.description: Identify tax-loss harvesting opportunities across taxable accounts. Finds positions with unrealized losses, suggests replacement securities, and tracks wash sale windows. Triggers on "tax-loss harvesting", "TLH", "harvest losses", "tax losses", "unrealized losses", or "year-end tax planning".

tools.name: Knowledge Work Plugins
tools.description: Open-source plugins for knowledge workers using Claude Cowork.

subTools.name: Instrument Data To Allotrope
subTools.description: Convert laboratory instrument output files (PDF, CSV, Excel, TXT) to Allotrope Simple Model (ASM) JSON format or flattened 2D CSV. Use this skill when scientists need to standardize instrument data for LIMS systems, data lakes, or downstream analysis. Supports auto-detection of instrument types. Outputs include full ASM JSON, flattened CSV for easy import, and exportable Python code for data engineers. Common triggers include converting instrument files, standardizing lab data, preparing data for upload to LIMS/ELN systems, or generating parser code for production pipelines.

subTools.name: Nextflow Development
subTools.description: Run nf-core bioinformatics pipelines (rnaseq, sarek, atacseq) on sequencing data. Use when analyzing RNA-seq, WGS/WES, or ATAC-seq data—either local FASTQs or public datasets from GEO/SRA. Triggers on nf-core, Nextflow, FASTQ analysis, variant calling, gene expression, differential expression, GEO reanalysis, GSE/GSM/SRR accessions, or samplesheet creation.

subTools.name: Scientific Problem Selection
subTools.description: This skill should be used when scientists need help with research problem selection, project ideation, troubleshooting stuck projects, or strategic scientific decisions. Use this skill when users ask to pitch a new research idea, work through a project problem, evaluate project risks, plan research strategy, navigate decision trees, or get help choosing what scientific problem to work on. Typical requests include "I have an idea for a project", "I'm stuck on my research", "help me evaluate this project", "what should I work on", or "I need strategic advice about my research".

subTools.name: Scvi Tools
subTools.description: Deep learning for single-cell analysis using scvi-tools. This skill should be used when users need (1) data integration and batch correction with scVI/scANVI, (2) ATAC-seq analysis with PeakVI, (3) CITE-seq multi-modal analysis with totalVI, (4) multiome RNA+ATAC analysis with MultiVI, (5) spatial transcriptomics deconvolution with DestVI, (6) label transfer and reference mapping with scANVI/scArches, (7) RNA velocity with veloVI, or (8) any deep learning-based single-cell method. Triggers include mentions of scVI, scANVI, totalVI, PeakVI, MultiVI, DestVI, veloVI, sysVI, scArches, variational autoencoder, VAE, batch correction, data integration, multi-modal, CITE-seq, multiome, reference mapping, latent space.

subTools.name: Single Cell Rna Qc
subTools.description: Performs quality control on single-cell RNA-seq data (.h5ad or .h5 files) using scverse best practices with MAD-based filtering and comprehensive visualizations. Use when users request QC analysis, filtering low-quality cells, assessing data quality, or following scverse/scanpy best practices for single-cell analysis.

subTools.name: Start
subTools.description: Set up your bio-research environment and explore available tools. Use when first getting oriented with the plugin, checking which literature, drug-discovery, or visualization MCP servers are connected, or surveying available analysis skills before starting a new project.

subTools.name: Customer Escalation
subTools.description: Package an escalation for engineering, product, or leadership with full context. Use when a bug needs engineering attention beyond normal support, multiple customers report the same issue, a customer is threatening to churn, or an issue has sat unresolved past its SLA.

subTools.name: Customer Research
subTools.description: Multi-source research on a customer question or topic with source attribution. Use when a customer asks something you need to look up, investigating whether a bug has been reported before, checking what was previously told to a specific account, or gathering background before drafting a response.

subTools.name: Draft Response
subTools.description: Draft a professional customer-facing response tailored to the situation and relationship. Use when answering a product question, responding to an escalation or outage, delivering bad news like a delay or won't-fix, declining a feature request, or replying to a billing issue.

subTools.name: Kb Article
subTools.description: Draft a knowledge base article from a resolved issue or common question. Use when a ticket resolution is worth documenting for self-service, the same question keeps coming up, a workaround needs to be published, or a known issue should be communicated to customers.

subTools.name: Ticket Triage
subTools.description: Triage and prioritize a support ticket or customer issue. Use when a new ticket comes in and needs categorization, assigning P1-P4 priority, deciding which team should handle it, or checking whether it's a duplicate or known issue before routing.

subTools.name: Analyze
subTools.description: Answer data questions -- from quick lookups to full analyses. Use when looking up a single metric, investigating what's driving a trend or drop, comparing segments over time, or preparing a formal data report for stakeholders.

subTools.name: Build Dashboard
subTools.description: Build an interactive HTML dashboard with charts, filters, and tables. Use when creating an executive overview with KPI cards, turning query results into a shareable self-contained report, building a team monitoring snapshot, or needing multiple charts with filters in one browser-openable file.

subTools.name: Create Viz
subTools.description: Create publication-quality visualizations with Python. Use when turning query results or a DataFrame into a chart, selecting the right chart type for a trend or comparison, generating a plot for a report or presentation, or needing an interactive chart with hover and zoom.

subTools.name: Data Visualization
subTools.description: Create effective data visualizations with Python (matplotlib, seaborn, plotly). Use when building charts, choosing the right chart type for a dataset, creating publication-quality figures, or applying design principles like accessibility and color theory.

subTools.name: Explore Data
subTools.description: Profile and explore a dataset to understand its shape, quality, and patterns. Use when encountering a new table or file, checking null rates and column distributions, spotting data quality issues like duplicates or suspicious values, or deciding which dimensions and metrics to analyze.

subTools.name: Sql Queries

subTools.name: Statistical Analysis

subTools.name: Validate Data
subTools.description: QA an analysis before sharing -- methodology, accuracy, and bias checks. Use when reviewing an analysis before a stakeholder presentation, spot-checking calculations and aggregation logic, verifying a SQL query's results look right, or assessing whether conclusions are actually supported by the data.

subTools.name: Write Query

subTools.name: Accessibility Review

subTools.name: Design Critique

subTools.name: Design System

subTools.name: Research Synthesis
subTools.description: Synthesize user research into themes, insights, and recommendations. Use when you have interview transcripts, survey results, usability test notes, support tickets, or NPS responses that need to be distilled into patterns, user segments, and prioritized next steps.

subTools.name: User Research
subTools.description: Plan, conduct, and synthesize user research. Trigger with "user research plan", "interview guide", "usability test", "survey design", "research questions", or when the user needs help with any aspect of understanding their users through research.

subTools.name: Ux Copy
subTools.description: Write or review UX copy — microcopy, error messages, empty states, CTAs. Trigger with "write copy for", "what should this button say?", "review this error message", or when naming a CTA, wording a confirmation dialog, filling an empty state, or writing onboarding text.

subTools.name: Architecture

subTools.name: Incident Response
subTools.description: Run an incident response workflow — triage, communicate, and write postmortem. Trigger with "we have an incident", "production is down", an alert that needs severity assessment, a status update mid-incident, or when writing a blameless postmortem after resolution.

subTools.name: Standup

subTools.name: Digest

subTools.name: Knowledge Synthesis
